title: Build a normalizing flow and the VITS KL term
brief: Implement affine coupling, ActNorm, and an invertible 1x1 convolution with exact log-determinants checked against autograd Jacobians, train a RealNVP by maximum likelihood, and write the KL term VITS trains with.
hints: coupling_forward: slice x into halves once, call net on the conditioning half, and torch.cat the two halves back in their original order. The log-determinant is s.sum(dim=1) because the Jacobian is triangular with exp(s) on the diagonal.
actnorm_init: with mean and std over dims (0, 2), exp(log_scale) = 1 / std and bias = -mean / std.
invconv_forward: torch.einsum('ij,bjt->bit', W, x) applies W at every time step; torch.linalg.slogdet(W).logabsdet is log |det W|.
RealNVP.sample runs the layers backwards: for i in reversed(range(len(self.nets))), with the same flip each layer used going forward.
vits_kl: the -0.5 replaces the posterior's -eps^2 / 2 by its expected value, which is why the formula has no eps in it.
